question_text: A 25-year-old woman is rushed to the emergency department after she was found unconscious in a house fire. She has no previous medical history available. At the hospital, the vital signs include: blood pressure 110/70 mm Hg, temperature 36.0°C (97.0°F), and heart rate 76/min with oxygen saturation 99% on room air. On physical exam she is unconscious. There are superficial burns on her hands and parts of her face. Her face and clothes are blackened with soot. What is the 1st best step while treating this patient?
